summary: Iteration 57 – Backend + Frontend regression for the three product changes (no 'Backup-Key' noise, market-closed instead of 'stale prices' on Fri/Sat, active-variant stats in maturity/diagnosis catalogues). Backend fully green (public API + pytest). Frontend mostly green – single truncation bug found in the diagnosis data-quality table that hides 6 of 7 Forex closed-market rows.

ui_bugs.issue: Data-quality table is hard-truncated with .slice(0,12) (line 137). Backend returns 23 rows (11 crypto + 7 Forex + 3 commodities + 2 indices). Only USDJPY renders with data-testid=diag-data-closed-USDJPY; EURUSD/GBPUSD/AUDUSD/NZDUSD/USDCAD/USDCHF (and GOLD/SILVER/OIL/QQQUSDT/SPYUSDT) are dropped, so the required '⏸ Markt geschlossen' cells for the other Forex symbols never appear even though backend market_closed=true.

action_items: Fix frontend AIDiagnosisPanel.js line 137: remove .slice(0,12) or raise the cap (e.g. .slice(0, 40)) so all data_quality rows – especially closed Forex markets – are visible. Otherwise 6 of 7 Forex symbols never show the '⏸ Markt geschlossen' cell required by the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: AIDiagnosisPanel.js truncates the data_quality table with a hard-coded .slice(0,12); with 23 possible rows this silently hides Forex+commodity+index rows that the diagnosis feature was rewritten to highlight.

Backend contract is clean and consistent: /api/ai/diagnosis returns has_pauses/market_closed/market_closed_reason on every data_quality row and variant_since on every setup row; /api/ai/playbook returns variant={since,label,total{trades,winrate,pnl}} on maturity rows and keeps trades/winrate/pnl scoped to active variant (crypto range_fade: trades=3 vs variant.total.trades=29 – exactly as specified).
/api/ai/status.providers_health: fallback_active is proper bool, active_fallbacks is list, key_status per provider carries {total, limited, limited_keys} – no crash, no 'Backup-Key' hint in UI.

Only regression: frontend AIDiagnosisPanel.js .slice(0,12) hides most Forex closed rows.
rca of the issue: Root cause – frontend/src/components/AIDiagnosisPanel.js line 137 renders `data.data_quality.slice(0, 12).map(...)`. Because /api/ai/diagnosis returns rows in the order crypto→forex→commodities→indices, only the first 11 crypto rows plus USDJPY (position 12) fit into the visible table. All remaining Forex symbols (EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD, NZDUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF) and the commodities/indices rows are dropped, so the new '⏸ Markt geschlossen · <age> min' cells (and their diag-data-closed-<SYMBOL> testids) never render for them – contradicting the spec bullet 'Datenqualitaets-Tabelle diag-data-table zeigt fuer Forex-Zeilen "⏸ Markt geschlossen"'. Reproduction: on a Saturday, open KI-Trader → Diagnose, scroll to 'DATENQUALITÄT · Kerzen-Frische & Orderflow-Quelle', only 12 rows visible; API-side `curl $REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/ai/diagnosis` returns 23 rows with the missing symbols carrying market_closed=true. Mitigation: raise the slice cap (or drop it) in AIDiagnosisPanel.js, or sort so all closed rows come first before truncation.
